newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil mulls new N. Sea oil development.
newsitem.headline: Statoil mulls new N. Sea oil development.

text.p: An oil and gas discovery in block 15/5 in the Norwegian sector of the North Sea could form the core of a new development in the Sleipner area, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday.
Statoil said it planned to drill an appraisal well this summer on the find, dubbed Glitne, which lies in production licence 048, adjacent to the boundary with the British continental shelf.
The discovery was made by Norsk Hydro ASA in 1995. Statoil took over operatorship in April under a swap deal.

The company's Status Weekly newsletter said that depending on the outcome of the appraisal well, a plan for development and operation could be submitted to the authorities during the first quarter of 1998.
